observations: Photo 2 shows a label reading 'SHARP AR-M201' on the control panel, confirming model.
Unit appears to be a monochrome desktop digital copier with scanner lid open in photos 0,1,3.
Visible dust and grime on the top cover and scanner bed area in photo 2.
No power-on screen, display readout, or printed test page is shown in any photo.
No photo shows the page counter, toner cartridge, or drum unit to verify newness.
No visible damage to the body, but photos are dim/low-light, limiting condition assessment.

No photo of the internal page counter display.

risks.risk: Drum/toner may be old or worn despite claim

risks.proof: Short video of a multi-page copy/print cycle

risks.risk: Dust/dirt visible may indicate heavier use or poor storage

proof_requests: Video of the copier powering on and producing a test print or copy
Photo of the internal page counter display
Photo of the drum/toner unit or purchase receipt for new parts
Clear daylight photos of the exterior and paper tray
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as a Sharp AR-M201 from photo 2, but all functional and usage claims are unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case as an unproven, possibly non-working basic monochrome copier comparable to similar low-tier Sharp units.
